title: Nourishing Gooey Mexican Radish Tostada
description: A vegan-friendly Mexican dish featuring radish, with a briny and gooey texture, perfect for midnight cravings. This tostada is a twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, using deep-fry tofu for added protein.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and deep-fry until golden brown.
Drain the tofu on paper towels and set aside.
Fry the corn tortillas in the same oil until crispy and golden brown.
Drain the tortillas on paper towels and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced radish, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
To assemble the tostada, place a fried tortilla on a plate, top with a spoonful of the radish mixture, and add some deep-fry tofu on top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, scallions, and a drizzle of olive oil.
